verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing support: the Server Administration Guide documents brute-force protection events (temporary or permanent lockout after login failures), which implies some authentication event capture. Users can also view account history. Nothing in the pack covers admin-activity auditing, streaming or exporting events to a SIEM, or tamper-evidence. Missing for 10: documented admin event logging, event listener/export or streaming to a SIEM, tamper-evident integrity guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
